name: triage-guide
description: A bug about invoice emails that customers notice on the dashboard. Both repos' descriptions could fit, but the channel's triage_guide says billing emails belong to acme-co/api, and customer-reported bugs to the support board (#317). The agent proposes one bug for acme-co/api, on the support board.

C0EXAMPLE1.triage_guide:
Anything about invoices or billing emails goes to api, even when customers notice it on the dashboard.
A bug a customer reported goes on the support board. Planned feature work goes on the roadmap board.

repos.description: The customer web app: dashboard, login, reports
The public REST API and the billing service behind it

boards.description: Planned work for the next two quarters

events.text: A customer says the invoice email they got this morning shows last month's total, and the dashboard link in it shows the right one.
Same for two other customers on the annual plan.

calls.title: Invoice email shows last month's total

arguments.title: Invoice emails show the previous month's total
arguments.body:
## Problem
Customers on the annual plan get invoice emails showing last month's total. The dashboard, linked from the same email, shows the right one. Three customers have reported it.

## Suggested approach
Drafted by the agent from the discussion; adjust before starting.

1. Find where the invoice email takes its total from.
2. Make it use the same period as the dashboard.
3. Add a test for an annual-plan invoice.

## Acceptance
- [ ] An invoice email shows the same total as the dashboard
- [ ] Annual-plan invoices are covered by a test

## Context
No related issue was found. Open question: are monthly-plan invoices affected too?

boards.reason: Customers reported it, and the triage guide puts those on support
